pages.text: Fit a wagon stool into one empty cargo slot. In either form, use its seat to sit, sneak to dismount, and sneak-use to remove it.$(br2)Choose a free stool with room for the rider’s whole body. Leave extra clearance for tall entities and keep surrounding passages clear. Drive from the driver’s seat.

Eligible mobs approaching an empty stool can board automatically. Players board by right-clicking. Use a free stool with a lead in hand to seat a led mob and recover its lead.$(br2)Seat passengers before moving so they travel with the wagon. Choose the Wagon Passenger task for maids riding cargo stools.

pages.text: The top row uses matching planks and determines the stool’s wood.
